# PART 1 — UNIVERSAL

## Architecture
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Pattern | Component-based — feature folders, isolated from cross-cutting concerns |
| Components | Presentational vs container (or composables/hooks) — split by responsibility |
| State | Centralised store for shared/global state — local state for UI-only concerns |
| External | API client/service layer only — never direct fetch/axios in components |
| Start | Mock-first (MSW/mock service) before real API |
| Component | One responsibility — split if doing two things |

## Code Quality
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Components | Delegate only — zero business logic, data-fetching, or side-effects in presentational components; push to hooks/composables/services |
| Injection | Service/hook abstraction — never call API clients directly from JSX/template |
| Config | Env vars only — no hardcoded values, never baked into the bundle |
| Dead code | Delete — never comment out |

## PR Rules
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Max lines | {from manifest.pr_rules.max_lines_per_pr} |
| Max files | {from manifest.pr_rules.max_files_per_pr} |
| Tests | Same PR always |
| Class max | 200 lines — split before commit |
| Over limit | Estimate → SPLIT A/B/C → confirm → one at a time |

## Testing
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Pairing | Every class/component has paired test |
| Unit | Mock all external dependencies |
| Naming | should_{expected}_when_{condition} |
| Coverage | As specified in tech stack (Part 2) |

## Logging
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Format | Structured JSON always |
| PII | Never in any log at any level |
| Trace | Correlation/trace ID on every line |
| Level | INFO=business WARN=recoverable ERROR=failure |

## Error Handling
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Exceptions | All extend base application exception |
| Handler | Single global handler |
| Response | errorCode + message + timestamp — no stack trace |

## Git
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Branch | feature/{n} fix/{n} chore/{n} |
| Commit | {type}({scope}): {description} |
| PR ref | Every PR references TASK-NNN or CHG-NNN |
| Merge | No direct commits to main or develop |

## Containerization & Hosting (OPS-7)
| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Build output | Static assets only — `npm run build` produces the deployable artifact |
| Serving | nginx (`-alpine`) or CDN + object storage (S3/Cloud Storage + CloudFront/Cloud CDN) |
| SPA fallback | All non-asset routes rewrite to `/index.html` — client-side router resolves the path |
| Env config | Runtime config (`/config.json` fetched at boot) or build-time env vars injected by CI — never hardcoded; no secrets baked into the JS bundle |
| CSP headers | `Content-Security-Policy` set at the edge/server — no `unsafe-inline` for scripts |
| Cache-Control | `index.html` → `no-cache`; hashed assets (`*.{hash}.js/css`) → `immutable, max-age=31536000` |
| SRI | `integrity` + `crossorigin` attributes on every third-party `<script>`/`<link>` |
| Health | `healthcheck` on the serving container (e.g. `curl -f http://localhost/`) |

See .specify/templates/docker-config-template.md for ready-to-use
multi-stage Dockerfile and nginx config matching these rules.

## SDD Workflow
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Order | SPECIFY→[GATE-1]→VALIDATE→ANALYZE→CLARIFY→PLAN-ARCH→PLAN-HLD→PLAN-LLD (mvp+)→PLAN-ADR (mvp+)→TASK→IMPLEMENT→RELEASE |
| Gates | GATE-1 before VALIDATE · VALIDATE before ANALYZE · CLARIFY before PLAN-ARCH · no unresolved [ASSUMPTION-NNN] before PLAN-ARCH (AI-8) · TASK approved before IMPLEMENT · all tasks merged before RELEASE |
| Change | Update context.md first — never code first |

## Core Principles
| Principle | Applied As |
|---|---|
| Specification First | No code before spec + TASK approved |
| Test Paired | Paired test with every component — same PR, never after |
| Traceability | task → story → FR → context — always |
| Component-First | UI built from small, composable, single-responsibility components |
| Accessible | Every component meets the Accessibility bar from Tech Stack (WCAG/axe-core) |
| Performant | Lazy-load routes/components; track Core Web Vitals budgets |
| {derived from domain} | {how it applies} |

## Never Do
| Rule | Reason |
|---|---|
| {extracted from context} | {why} |

## IF framework=react OR vue OR angular (auto-applied)
| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Components | Single responsibility — split > 150 lines |
| State | Global store for shared — local useState for UI only |
| API calls | Service layer — never directly in components |
| Styling | Project styling solution — no inline styles |
| A11y | axe-core on every component test |
| Testing | Testing Library — no implementation details |
